how.title: From request to credit in 4 steps

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Online, here on the site, or on WhatsApp +258 87 387 8534.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Our team reviews your request and calls you to explain the terms.

steps.title: Bring your documents
steps.text: Bring your documents to our office at Av. Agostinho Neto, 662.

steps.title: Get your credit
steps.text: Once approved, the money is paid out.

requirements.title: What you need to apply
requirements.text: General documents for any credit request. If you're unsure about a document, talk to us before coming to the office.
items: Bank statement for the last 3 months
requirements.business: For business credit: also a business licence (Alvará) and commercial certificate

about.title: Your responsible choice in Maputo
paragraphs: NRP Microcredit supports your financial growth with fast, transparent credit solutions and clear terms from the very first conversation.
We offer personal loans, business credit and support for entrepreneurs, so everyone can find the right solution for their plans.

cards.title: Mission
cards.text: To support the financial growth of people and businesses with fast, responsible credit.

cards.title: Values
cards.text: Clear rates, closeness to our clients and respect for each person's ability to repay.

cards.title: Where we are
cards.text: Av. Agostinho Neto, 662, Maputo. Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 19:00.

trust.title: Responsible, transparent credit
trust.text: Clear rates from the first conversation: between 18% and 25% per month, depending on the loan. Talk to us before you decide.

contact.title: Apply for your loan today
contact.text: Leave your details and continue your request online. Our team will then call you.

quick.name: Full name
quick.note: You'll finish your request on the next page.

talk.title: Have questions? We'll contact you.
talk.text: Leave your details and tell us how you'd like to be contacted. We reply Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 19:00.
